verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੋ ਸਕਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise to sakal nidh pooran samu(n)dhr bikhai ha(n)s marajeevaa nihachai prasaadh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as treasures of pearls and diamonds are found in the sea, but only a seasoned evaluator of these precious stones who can dive deep into the bottom of sea can surely enjoy the pleasure of picking them up from there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਧ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਵਿਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise parabat heeraa maanik paaras sidh khanavaaraa khan jag vikhe pragaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as mountains have diamonds, rubies and philosopher stones those can purify metals into gold, but only an adept excavator can bring them out before the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਲਿਆਗਰ ਸੌਧਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੋਧ ਕੈ ਸੁਬਾਸੀ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਿਹਸਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ban bikhai maliaagar sauadhaa kapoor sodh kai subaasee subaas bihasaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a jungle has many aromatic trees like sandalwood, camphor etc., but only a perfumery expert can bring their fragrance out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਕਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹੈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਪਜਾਵਈ ॥੫੪੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurbaanee bikhai sakal padhaarath hai joiee joiee khojai soiee soiee nipajaaviee ||546||

en.bdb: Similarly Gurbani has all the precious items but whosoever would search and research them, he would be rewarded with those items that he so fondly desires.  (546)
